segments.title: December
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! December is the Party Season Survival Guide. Office parties, family dinners, and a January that is coming whether we like it or not. This month we help members get through the season, and set up the new year before it starts.

segments.title: ₹8.3L
segments.text: So, the number. Our December target for Kenkere House is 8.3 lakh rupees. That's 57 per cent up on last December. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 4.4 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 2.82 lakh, everything else 58,100, and comebacks 49,800. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 42 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 625 leads, 225 trials, and 42 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.
Here's where the offers come in. Five offers carry 5.85 lakh rupees, which is 71 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Boxing Day (Gloves Optional)
segments.text: First up, Boxing Day. Gloves optional. Two days only, twelve-class packs at twenty per cent off. That's 14 buyers, for 1.47 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone: pack buyers, members topping up, newcomers.

segments.title: Resolution Insurance (Claim Approved)
segments.text: Next, for newcomers, Resolution Insurance. Claim approved. Buy your first month now, start any day from the first to the tenth of January, and January's late-cancel fees are on us, plus a freeze for when life happens. That's 4 buyers, for 49,600 rupees.
segments.notes: First-time clients (phone verified); members buying for a January start.

segments.title: The Gift They Won’t Regift
segments.text: Then, the Gift They Won't Regift. A boxed gift: two classes, grip socks, and a thousand rupees off a first membership. That's 9 buyers, for 16,200 rupees.
segments.notes: Members and non-members buying for someone new; offices.

segments.title: The Ex-Files: Season Finale
segments.text: Also this month, for lapsed members, The Ex-Files: Season Finale. Ten per cent off to come back, fifteen on three months, and a plus-one to the NYE Countdown Class. That's 4 buyers, for 52,500 rupees.

segments.title: The Advent-ure Calendar (Opens in January)
segments.text: And finally, the Advent-ure Calendar, which opens in January. Renew in December and take home twelve doors of perks, one a week from the third of January: guest passes, a private, smoothies and a golden door. That's 8 buyers, for 3.2 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Advent-ure Calendars and gift boxes go on sale. Week two, every December renewal hears the calendar pitch, and offices get their gift boxes. Week three, Ugly Sweater Barre, and Resolution Insurance for the I'll start in January crowd. Week four, Boxing Day packs, and the NYE Countdown Class for our comeback members.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's December at Kenkere House. 8.3 lakh rupees, five offers, and 42 buyers to welcome. That's a wrap on 2027. See you on the mat in January.
